request.state: The carrier confirmed in writing that the parcel is lost. The customer replied that they still want the item and do not want their money back.

q1.instructions: Which of these actions should be taken next?

criteria.ship_a_replacement: Send the same item again at no charge.
criteria.refund_the_order: Give the money back and send nothing.
criteria.open_a_carrier_claim: Ask the carrier to investigate the parcel.
criteria.close_the_ticket: End the conversation with no further action.
